_comment: Authoring template for a codebase-kg code graph. This JSON is the INPUT format;
the committed artifact is knowledge/code_graph.db, built from it with:
python -m codebase_kg.build graph.json -o knowledge/code_graph.db
Delete this file after building — it is a working file, not an artifact. To edit an
existing graph, get this shape back with `python -m codebase_kg.export -o graph.json`.
Keys starting with _ are ignored by the builder. See SCHEMA.md for the full contract.
Every id in an `edges` list must be a node in this same document — the builder refuses
the whole file otherwise, which is how dangling edges are made impossible. This template
builds as-is; keep it that way as you edit.
_covers: Which files this graph is expected to cover, as globs relative to `root`.
WRITE THIS. Without it, coverage is inferred from the extensions already
anchored — which means a file type with NO coverage is invisible rather than
reported. Build config, manifests and resource files are the usual casualties.
`exempt` subtracts: in scope, deliberately unmapped, and recorded as a decision
rather than looking identical to an oversight.
`**/` spans directories, `*` and `?` stay inside one, a trailing `/` means

nodes._comment: Minimal node. id + kind are required; description is all but required.
nodes.description: Ranks the main feed by freshness, breaking flag and normalized source/category weight; stable sort, identity on cold start.

nodes._comment: A node with a peer in another codebase. parity=matched REQUIRES counterpart and must NOT carry divergence.
nodes.description: Persisted bookmark in the saved_articles table, indexed by articleId for dedup.

nodes._comment: parity=divergent REQUIRES both counterpart and a one-line divergence.
nodes.description: Scores articles per category from in-memory signals; defined but not wired into the feed.
nodes.divergence: Android: pure, persisted, wired. iOS: actor, in-memory, unwired.

nodes._comment: parity=<codebase>-only must have NEITHER counterpart NOR divergence.
nodes.description: Time-windowed warm-amber theme applied between 22:00 and 06:00 local.

_comment: A link into a DIFFERENT KIND of graph in this repo's knowledge/ — a screen
graph, a docs graph. NOT `counterpart`, which is parity between two CODEBASES
and is CHECK-constrained to a valid parity triple: a screen node has no parity
status, so `counterpart` physically cannot hold this.
`target` is <db-file>#<node-id>, relative to knowledge/ and NEVER absolute —
an absolute path is a fact about one machine and breaks on the next clone.
`kind` says what the link means from this side; empty means unspecified.
A target whose peer graph is not in this repo is a warning, not an error:
each graph must be fully usable alone. A target whose peer EXISTS but lacks
the node is an error. See SCHEMA.md §12, and cartographer's docs/GRAPH-LINKS.md.
nodes.description: The main feed screen; renders ranked articles and hosts the bookmark action.

_comment: `references` records where a fact this node DEPENDS ON is documented — a
platform API page, a spec, an RFC, an upstream issue — so that when an SDK
moves you can list what the code relies on. NOT `external_links`, which
point at a node in another graph.
`url` is required. `kind` is a short tag (platform-api, spec, rfc, issue).
`path` and `symbol` are optional and narrow the reference to one file or one
function. They MUST equal one of this node's own anchors, or the build is
refused: anchors are checked against source, free text is not. To narrow to
a method, anchor the method. See SCHEMA.md §13.
nodes.description: The bookmark toggle; expands its touch target to the 48dp minimum.
